parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cover_letter_few_shot_library ( id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, role_category VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'ALL', company_example VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, para1_hook_html TEXT NOT NULL, para2_stewardship_html TEXT NOT NULL, para3_impact_story_html TEXT NOT NULL, para4_resilience_html TEXT NOT NULL, para5_closing_html TEXT NOT NULL, is_active BOOLEAN DEFAULT TRUE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cover_letter_generations ( resume_id VARCHAR(100) PRIMARY KEY, s_no VARCHAR(50), company_name VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, position_title VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, salutation_html TEXT NOT NULL, para1_hook_html TEXT NOT NULL, para2_stewardship_html TEXT NOT NULL, para3_impact_story_html TEXT NOT NULL, para4_resilience_html TEXT NOT NULL, para5_closing_html TEXT NOT NULL, cl_drive_file_id VARCHAR(200), cl_drive_web_link TEXT, cl_status VARCHAR(64) DEFAULT 'Generated', revision_count INTEGER DEFAULT 1, last_reviewer_note TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ); -- 1. Remove old duplicate Sept 23 cover_letter rules DELETE FROM learned_rules WHERE id IN (5, 10); -- 2. Clean up Rule #12 so it is a pure global Title Case & Tableau rule (without Damco's 'LLM over SQL') UPDATE learned_rules SET section_name = 'skills', role_category = 'ALL', rule_instruction = 'All skill names and category names in Core Skills MUST be in Title Case (e.g., Consulting, Stakeholder Management, Data Profiling). Prefer Tableau over Power BI unless Power BI is explicitly required.' WHERE id = 12; -- 3. Replace cover letter sample with the Short-Sentence, HR-Aware Industry-Standard sample DELETE FROM cover_letter_few_shot_library; INSERT INTO cover_letter_few_shot_library ( role_category, company_example, para1_hook_html, para2_stewardship_html, para3_impact_story_html, para4_resilience_html, para5_closing_html, is_active ) VALUES ( 'ALL', 'Grounded Enterprise & Operations Analytics (Gold Standard Sample)', '

I am writing to apply for the Technical Business Analyst role at Turing. What stood out to me in the job description is the focus on turning messy day-to-day operations into clean data models and clear reports. Before spending the last five years in data analytics, I ran my own small marketing agency for ten years. That mix taught me how much time teams lose when numbers do not match across different tools. Fixing those gaps between business teams and engineering is the part of the job I enjoy most.

', '

Outside of writing SQL queries and building Tableau dashboards, I spend my free time on my terrace in Gurugram growing mushrooms and automating small daily tasks with n8n. Growing mushrooms in North India''s weather is not a fancy hobby. It comes down to watching basic details closely. If moisture or airflow slips even a little, the whole batch fails. I bring that same habit to my work when I check data quality, map workflows, or build reports that leaders rely on.

', '

I also believe analysis is only useful when it solves a real problem on the ground. At Concentrix, our hiring data showed that new joiners were struggling once they started work. Sending another dashboard to management was not fixing the issue. I looked closely at the hiring steps and worked with leadership to bring our training team directly into the interview stage. That simple change improved hire quality by 84%. In my current role at Highspring India, I use the same practical approach across four engineering teams to automate recurring reports and cut manual work by 40%.

', '

My day-to-day work covers SQL, Python, Tableau, and working closely with business and tech teams. If the team at Turing uses an internal tool I have not worked with yet, I learn new systems quickly. Practical challenges early in my career taught me how to stay resourceful, focus on the basics, and get things done without hand-holding. When I take ownership of a task, nobody has to follow up twice.

', '

I would welcome the chance to bring this steady, practical approach to Turing. Thank you for your time and consideration, and I look forward to speaking with you soon.

', TRUE ); -- 4. Update or seed the Grounded 1-Page Cover Letter rule with HR-aware & short-sentence enforcement DELETE FROM learned_rules WHERE section_name = 'cover_letter' AND triggered_by_comment = 'System Grounded CL Rule'; INSERT INTO learned_rules (section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, is_active) VALUES ( 'cover_letter', 'ALL', 'Keep the Cover Letter strictly to 1 A4 page (260-320 words total across 5 paragraphs) in standard justified business letter format. Write in short, simple, human-like sentences (12-18 words per sentence, max 20 words). Address the company or functional department by name (never say "your team" since the recipient is often HR/Talent Acquisition). NEVER use em-dashes (—), semicolons, mid-paragraph bolding, or fancy/AI words like disparate, stewardship, rigorous, multifaceted, synergetic, leverage, orchestrate, intersection, friction, cohort, or paradigm.', 'System Grounded CL Rule', TRUE ); -- 5. Return full audit summary SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cover_letter_generations) AS total_cover_letters_stored, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cover_letter_generations WHERE cl_status IN ('LGTM', 'Approved', 'Approved & Learned')) AS approved_cover_letters, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM learned_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE AND LOWER(section_name) IN ('cover_letter', 'cl')) AS total_cl_learned_rules, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cover_letter_few_shot_library WHERE is_active = TRUE) AS total_cl_few_shot_examples, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(c), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT resume_id, s_no, company_name, position_title, revision_count, cl_status, last_reviewer_note, updated_at FROM cover_letter_generations ORDER BY updated_at DESC LIMIT 5 ) c) AS latest_cover_letters, (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(l), '[]'::json) FROM ( SELECT id, section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, company_context, created_at FROM learned_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE AND LOWER(section_name) IN ('cover_letter', 'cl', 'skills', 'global', 'all') ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 10 ) l) AS latest_cl_learned_rules;

parameters.query:
SELECT
  (SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM (
    SELECT resume_id, role_category, extracted_jd_keywords, summary_html
    FROM resume_generations
    WHERE (resume_id = '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' AND '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' <> '')
       OR (s_no = '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' AND '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' <> '')
       OR LOWER(TRIM(company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json["Company"] }}'))
    ORDER BY updated_at DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) r) AS resume_context,
  (SELECT row_to_json(f) FROM (
    SELECT * FROM cover_letter_few_shot_library
    WHERE is_active = TRUE
    ORDER BY id DESC
    LIMIT 1
  ) f) AS cl_reference,
  (SELECT COALESCE(json_agg(rule_instruction), '[]'::json) FROM (
    SELECT rule_instruction
    FROM learned_rules
    WHERE is_active = TRUE
      AND (LOWER(section_name) LIKE '%cover%' OR LOWER(section_name) = 'cl' OR LOWER(section_name) IN ('global', 'all'))
    ORDER BY id ASC
  ) lr) AS cl_rules;

    SELECT *
    FROM cover_letter_generations
    WHERE (resume_id = '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' AND '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' <> '')

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO learned_rules (section_name, role_category, rule_instruction, triggered_by_comment, company_context, is_active)
SELECT
  'cover_letter',
  'ALL',
  $1,
  $2,
  $3,
  TRUE
WHERE '{{ $json.shouldSaveLearnedRule }}' = 'true'
  AND LENGTH(TRIM($1)) > 5
  AND $1 !~* '\m(for this cover letter|for this cl|this cover letter only|only for this cover letter|for this resume|this resume only|only for this resume|just for this)\M'
  AND $2 !~* '\m(for this cover letter|for this cl|this cover letter only|only for this cover letter|for this resume|this resume only|only for this resume|just for this)\M'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM learned_rules
    WHERE LOWER(TRIM(rule_instruction)) = LOWER(TRIM($1))
       OR (LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(triggered_by_comment, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM($2)) AND LOWER(TRIM(COALESCE(company_context, ''))) = LOWER(TRIM($3)))
  );

UPDATE cover_letter_generations
SET cl_status = 'Approved', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
WHERE (resume_id = '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' AND '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' <> '')
   OR (s_no = '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' AND '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' <> '')
   OR LOWER(TRIM(company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json["Company"] }}'));

DELETE FROM cover_letter_few_shot_library
WHERE company_example IN (
  SELECT 'Approved CL - ' || company_name || ' (' || position_title || ')'
  FROM cover_letter_generations
  WHERE (resume_id = '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' AND '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' <> '')
     OR (s_no = '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' AND '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' <> '')
     OR LOWER(TRIM(company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json["Company"] }}'))
);

INSERT INTO cover_letter_few_shot_library (
  role_category,
  company_example,
  para1_hook_html,
  para2_stewardship_html,
  para3_impact_story_html,
  para4_resilience_html,
  para5_closing_html,
  is_active
)
SELECT
  'ALL',
  'Approved CL - ' || company_name || ' (' || position_title || ')',
  para1_hook_html,
  para2_stewardship_html,
  para3_impact_story_html,
  para4_resilience_html,
  para5_closing_html,
  TRUE
FROM cover_letter_generations
WHERE (resume_id = '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' AND '{{ $json["Resume_id"] }}' <> '')
   OR (s_no = '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' AND '{{ $json["S. No."] }}' <> '')
   OR LOWER(TRIM(company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM('{{ $json["Company"] }}'))
ORDER BY updated_at DESC
LIMIT 1;
